## Description

Sign-up asks first for the organisation type, Clinic or Hospital (there is no individual or solo-doctor account; a doctor working alone registers a clinic and is its owner). The wizard (MDV-P1-004, MDV-P1-061) then collects the per-type documents proposed in ADR-016: registration number and validity, tax number, owner identity (Hospital: authorised signatory and IT contact), and for an owner who is a doctor the council registration number and expiry. Files go to private Blob. Submit moves the request from Draft to Submitted; the applicant sees a status page (Submitted, Needs changes with the reason, Approved, Rejected) and can resubmit after Needs changes. Hospital connection to a HIS or SSO is P7.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an applicant, when they start sign-up, then they must choose Clinic or Hospital and are asked only for that type's documents.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a required document or field is missing or fails the country rules, when they submit, then the server refuses with errors under the field announced to screen readers.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a Submitted request, when the applicant signs in, then they see its status and, for Needs changes, the reviewer's reason, and can edit and resubmit.
- [ ] **AC4.** Uploaded files are validated (type, size), malware-scanned, stored in private Blob and readable only by Medvya operations.
- [ ] **AC5.** The flow works in English, Hindi and Arabic (RTL), keyboard-complete, axe clean; no PHI in logs, URLs or telemetry.
